settings.title: Handcrafted Wabi-Sabi Home Decor
settings.subtitle: Where imperfection meets intention. Each piece tells a story of natural materials and slow craftsmanship.

settings.label: Our Story
settings.title: Where Less Becomes More
settings.richtext:
Born from a love for Japanese aesthetics and European craftsmanship, our collection celebrates the beauty found in imperfection. Every piece tells a story of hands that shaped it, materials that grew slowly, and designs that honor time rather than chase it.

We work directly with skilled artisans who weave cotton rope by hand, pour soy wax candles in small batches, and shape ceramics with intention. No two pieces are exactly alike — and that is precisely the point.

settings.label: Our Philosophy
settings.quote: Wabi-sabi is not a style. It is a way of seeing — a quiet appreciation for the worn, the weathered, the simply beautiful.
settings.text: From hand-knotted table runners to cotton rope baskets, our collection invites you to slow down. To fill your home with textures that feel good. To celebrate the imperfect, the handmade, and the real.
